concept.title: Hardcoding content
concept.shortdesc: Problem: Copy-pasting repeated content instead of using reuse mechanisms.

conbody.p: Problem: Copy-pasting repeated content instead of using reuse mechanisms.
Impact: Inconsistencies, higher maintenance effort, translation cost increases.
Solution: Use <conref/>, <keyref/>, and <conkeyref/> for reusable content. Maintain reusable content in a shared /global location.
